title: ruta graveolens var. chalepensis
intro: Ruta graveolens var. chalepensis, commonly known as Chalepensis Rue, is a variant of the Ruta graveolens plant, belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Chalepensis Rue include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chalepensis Rue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
